responsibility: Provides the top-level IRA and reload/LRA pass integration for RTL register allocation. It orchestrates IRA initialization, region building, coloring, emission, and handoff either to LRA or old reload; performs post-reload cleanup and DF rescanning; handles diagnostics such as frame-pointer/global-register conflicts and stack-check warnings; and defines the RTL pass objects for the ira and reload passes. This file is the control-plane entry point rather than an algorithm implementation for any single IRA subphase.
same_name_distinction: This is the IRA implementation/driver source: it runs IRA and the reload handoff, including pass objects and the choice between LRA and old reload. The same-stem header gcc/ira.h instead exposes IRA’s cross-module interface, target data tables, global state, and helper declarations for other RTL code.
